question: What is the scope of the prohibition against the eight unsuitable seats in ritual practice?
premises: A group of eight seats has been described.
These seats are to be avoided.
The avoidance applies in all rites.
inference: The eight unsuitable seats must be avoided in all ritual activities.
uncertainties: The exact enumeration of the eight seats depends on the preceding list.
plain_english: Thus, O goddess, one should avoid these eight seats in all rites.
